blocks.text: Except, naturally, he doesn't.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Never Outside the Heart

blocks.text: We've reached an extraordinary culmination.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The entire Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa has been circling one fundamental problem:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The entire Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa has been circling one fundamental problem:

blocks.text: How can the absolute consciousness become an apparently differentiated world without ceasing to be absolute?
blocks.directed: How can the absolute consciousness become an apparently differentiated world without ceasing to be absolute?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta has investigated the problem through language.

blocks.text: Through the stages of speech.
blocks.directed: Through the stages of speech.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Through mantra.
blocks.directed: Through mantra.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Through sensation.

blocks.text: Through memory.
blocks.directed: Through memory.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Through the limits of conceptual thought.
blocks.directed: Through the limits of conceptual thought.

blocks.text: Through the distinction between subject and object.
blocks.directed: Through the distinction between subject and object.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Through the relation between ritual and liberation.
blocks.directed: Through the relation between ritual and liberation.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And now, through a banyan seed.
blocks.directed: And now, through a banyan seed.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The seed is an elegant analogy because it prevents us from treating manifest differentiation as a completely foreign addition.
blocks.directed: The seed is an elegant analogy because it prevents us from treating manifest differentiation as a completely foreign addition.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The great tree can emerge from the seed because the seed possesses the relevant generative power.
blocks.directed: The great tree can emerge from the seed because the seed possesses the relevant generative power.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: But the completed tree is not simply present as a miniature physical object.
blocks.directed: But the completed tree is not simply present as a miniature physical object.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Its presence must be understood according to the seed's mode of existence.
blocks.directed: Its presence must be understood according to the seed's mode of existence.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Likewise, says Abhinavagupta, the entire world is present within the Heart.
blocks.directed: Likewise, says Abhinavagupta, the entire world is present within the Heart.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: But not as a physically compressed inventory of separate objects.
blocks.directed: But not as a physically compressed inventory of separate objects.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The Heart is the supreme power of self-aware manifestation.
blocks.directed: The Heart is the supreme power of self-aware manifestation.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: It is the ground through which differentiation arises.
blocks.directed: It is the ground through which differentiation arises.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And it remains non-separate from what is manifested.
blocks.directed: And it remains non-separate from what is manifested.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: What exactly is recognised?
blocks.directed: What exactly is recognised?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Not simply the proposition:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Not simply the proposition:

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: “The world is in consciousness.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “The world is in consciousness.”

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: That can be memorised.
blocks.directed: That can be memorised.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Written on a wall.
blocks.directed: Written on a wall.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Printed on a postcard.
blocks.directed: Printed on a postcard.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Repeated during meditation.
blocks.directed: Repeated during meditation.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The real enquiry is what the words mean.
blocks.directed: The real enquiry is what the words mean.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: What is consciousness?
blocks.directed: What is consciousness?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: What is the relation between appearance and awareness?
blocks.directed: What is the relation between appearance and awareness?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: What is the status of the subject that apprehends the world?
blocks.directed: What is the status of the subject that apprehends the world?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Does the subject itself appear as another object?
blocks.directed: Does the subject itself appear as another object?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: What allows the distinction between knowing and known to arise?
blocks.directed: What allows the distinction between knowing and known to arise?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And what is the reality of the manifestness through which both are present?
blocks.directed: And what is the reality of the manifestness through which both are present?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta's answer is the self-luminous, reflexively aware, absolutely free consciousness of Śiva.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta's answer is the self-luminous, reflexively aware, absolutely free consciousness of Śiva.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The limited subject is not ultimately separate from it.
blocks.directed: The limited subject is not ultimately separate from it.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The world is its manifestation.
blocks.directed: The world is its manifestation.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And recognition of that relation is liberation.
blocks.directed: And recognition of that relation is liberation.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The initiation that requires no sacrificial fire
blocks.directed: The initiation that requires no sacrificial fire

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Why then no sesame and ghee?
blocks.directed: Why then no sesame and ghee?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Because the ultimate reality is not produced by an offering.
blocks.directed: Because the ultimate reality is not produced by an offering.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The fire ceremony belongs to the differentiated order of action.
blocks.directed: The fire ceremony belongs to the differentiated order of action.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: It can have religious significance.
blocks.directed: It can have religious significance.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: It can express devotion.
blocks.directed: It can express devotion.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: It can form part of a transmitted ritual discipline.
blocks.directed: It can form part of a transmitted ritual discipline.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: But it cannot manufacture the supreme consciousness that makes every action and offering manifest in the first place.
blocks.directed: But it cannot manufacture the supreme consciousness that makes every action and offering manifest in the first place.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: When the subject truly recognises the Heart, the final purpose of initiation is accomplished.
blocks.directed: When the subject truly recognises the Heart, the final purpose of initiation is accomplished.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Not because the person has acquired a new independent divine substance.
blocks.directed: Not because the person has acquired a new independent divine substance.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: But because the false understanding of their ultimate nature has been overcome.
blocks.directed: But because the false understanding of their ultimate nature has been overcome.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The rite may be a means of revealing.
blocks.directed: The rite may be a means of revealing.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Recognition is not a product manufactured by the rite.
blocks.directed: Recognition is not a product manufactured by the rite.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The metaphysical joke
blocks.directed: The metaphysical joke

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Imagine a person wandering through the universe searching for the ultimate cause of everything.
blocks.directed: Imagine a person wandering through the universe searching for the ultimate cause of everything.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They study cosmology.
blocks.directed: They study cosmology.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They investigate matter.
blocks.directed: They investigate matter.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They examine the brain.
blocks.directed: They examine the brain.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They learn philosophy.
blocks.directed: They learn philosophy.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They read Sanskrit.
blocks.directed: They read Sanskrit.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They memorise the tattvas.
blocks.directed: They memorise the tattvas.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They master mantra.
blocks.directed: They master mantra.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They receive initiation.
blocks.directed: They receive initiation.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They contemplate divine forms.
blocks.directed: They contemplate divine forms.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: They investigate consciousness.
blocks.directed: They investigate consciousness.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And finally somebody asks:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And finally somebody asks:

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: “What is the reality in which the entire search is appearing?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “What is the reality in which the entire search is appearing?”

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The person looks around.
blocks.directed: The person looks around.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: There is the body.
blocks.directed: There is the body.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: There are sensations.
blocks.directed: There are sensations.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: There are memories.
blocks.directed: There are memories.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: There is the world.
blocks.directed: There is the world.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: There is the question.
blocks.directed: There is the question.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And there is awareness of it all.
blocks.directed: And there is awareness of it all.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The enquiry changes.
blocks.directed: The enquiry changes.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Instead of searching for consciousness as an additional object in the universe, the person examines the nature of the awareness through which the universe is present.
blocks.directed: Instead of searching for consciousness as an additional object in the universe, the person examines the nature of the awareness through which the universe is present.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And Abhinavagupta says that this awareness, understood in its supreme nature, is the Heart of Bhairava.
blocks.directed: And Abhinavagupta says that this awareness, understood in its supreme nature, is the Heart of Bhairava.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Not a little region in the chest.
blocks.directed: Not a little region in the chest.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Not a private psychological possession.
blocks.directed: Not a private psychological possession.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Not an object that another object could observe from outside.
blocks.directed: Not an object that another object could observe from outside.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The universal ground of manifestation.
blocks.directed: The universal ground of manifestation.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The tree.
blocks.directed: The tree.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The seed.
blocks.directed: The seed.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The branches.
blocks.directed: The branches.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The leaves.
blocks.directed: The leaves.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The fruit.
blocks.directed: The fruit.

blocks.text: The person searching.
blocks.directed: The person searching.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The question.
blocks.directed: The question.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The act of recognition.
blocks.directed: The act of recognition.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: All manifest within the one conscious reality.
blocks.directed: All manifest within the one conscious reality.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And in the highest sense, the recognition of that reality is initiation.
blocks.directed: And in the highest sense, the recognition of that reality is initiation.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The final challenge
blocks.directed: The final challenge

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: But there is one more problem.
blocks.directed: But there is one more problem.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: If all of this is true, how should a person live?
blocks.directed: If all of this is true, how should a person live?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Should they stop worshipping?
blocks.directed: Should they stop worshipping?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Stop practising?
blocks.directed: Stop practising?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Stop using mantras?
blocks.directed: Stop using mantras?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Stop performing rituals?
blocks.directed: Stop performing rituals?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Should they abandon the body because the supreme Heart isn't spatially confined?
blocks.directed: Should they abandon the body because the supreme Heart isn't spatially confined?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Should they reject differentiated experience because consciousness is undivided?
blocks.directed: Should they reject differentiated experience because consciousness is undivided?

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta's answer is not simply yes.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta's answer is not simply yes.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Remember the phrase we just examined:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Remember the phrase we just examined:

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Anuttara is not established by abandoning the differentiated forms.
blocks.directed: Anuttara is not established by abandoning the differentiated forms.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: That is the crucial insight.
blocks.directed: That is the crucial insight.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The absolute is not threatened by manifestation.
blocks.directed: The absolute is not threatened by manifestation.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The divine freedom of consciousness includes the power to appear as the world.
blocks.directed: The divine freedom of consciousness includes the power to appear as the world.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Therefore worship can continue.
blocks.directed: Therefore worship can continue.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Mantra can continue.
blocks.directed: Mantra can continue.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The body can continue.
blocks.directed: The body can continue.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The senses can continue.
blocks.directed: The senses can continue.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Thought can continue.
blocks.directed: Thought can continue.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And the practitioner can engage these not as alien objects standing outside the supreme Self, but as manifestations of its powers.
blocks.directed: And the practitioner can engage these not as alien objects standing outside the supreme Self, but as manifestations of its powers.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: That is precisely what the next ritual exposition will investigate.
blocks.directed: That is precisely what the next ritual exposition will investigate.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The problem is no longer merely how to transcend ritual.
blocks.directed: The problem is no longer merely how to transcend ritual.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: It is how to understand ritual from within nondual recognition.
blocks.directed: It is how to understand ritual from within nondual recognition.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And this is where Abhinavagupta becomes especially extraordinary.
blocks.directed: And this is where Abhinavagupta becomes especially extraordinary.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: A lesser thinker might declare:
blocks.directed: [short pause] A lesser thinker might declare:

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: “Everything is one, so all rituals are pointless.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Everything is one, so all rituals are pointless.”

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Another might declare:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Another might declare:

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: “Ritual is absolutely necessary, so direct recognition cannot be enough.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Ritual is absolutely necessary, so direct recognition cannot be enough.”

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta refuses both simplifications.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta refuses both simplifications.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The highest initiation is recognition.
blocks.directed: The highest initiation is recognition.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: But ritual can express that recognition through differentiated powers.
blocks.directed: But ritual can express that recognition through differentiated powers.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The ceremony cannot create the supreme Heart.
blocks.directed: The ceremony cannot create the supreme Heart.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: But it can become a manifestation of the Heart's self-awareness.
blocks.directed: But it can become a manifestation of the Heart's self-awareness.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And now we understand why he returns to ritual after declaring the superiority of direct knowledge.
blocks.directed: And now we understand why he returns to ritual after declaring the superiority of direct knowledge.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: He isn't contradicting himself.
blocks.directed: He isn't contradicting himself.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: He is explaining how differentiated activity can remain meaningful without compromising the ultimate nonduality of consciousness.
blocks.directed: He is explaining how differentiated activity can remain meaningful without compromising the ultimate nonduality of consciousness.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The seed has become a tree.
blocks.directed: The seed has become a tree.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The tree has spread its branches.
blocks.directed: The tree has spread its branches.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The entire world has emerged.
blocks.directed: The entire world has emerged.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And the supreme Heart has not been diminished by a single leaf.
blocks.directed: And the supreme Heart has not been diminished by a single leaf.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The universe can manifest without becoming independent of its ground.
blocks.directed: The universe can manifest without becoming independent of its ground.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The subject can know without ceasing to be consciousness.
blocks.directed: The subject can know without ceasing to be consciousness.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The practitioner can worship without positing an ultimately separate god.
blocks.directed: The practitioner can worship without positing an ultimately separate god.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And initiation can disclose a reality that was never manufactured by the ceremony.
blocks.directed: And initiation can disclose a reality that was never manufactured by the ceremony.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: That is the extraordinary synthesis.
blocks.directed: That is the extraordinary synthesis.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: The world is not something consciousness must escape. It is something whose ultimate nature consciousness must recognise.
blocks.directed: The world is not something consciousness must escape. It is something whose ultimate nature consciousness must recognise.

blocks.section: XII. The Final Philosophical Synthesis: The Universe Was Nev
blocks.text: And somewhere in medieval Kashmir, Abhinavagupta has managed to explain the entire universe through a banyan seed, abolish the absolute necessity of a fire offering, and then immediately begin a seven-verse manual of ritual worship.
blocks.directed: And somewhere in medieval Kashmir, Abhinavagupta has managed to explain the entire universe through a banyan seed, abolish the absolute necessity of a fire offering, and then immediately begin a seven-verse manual of ritual worship.

blocks.text: The man was absolutely relentless.
